item.summary: Kripos, including the National Cybercrime Centre (NC3), traced cash that had been exchanged into cryptocurrency as part of operation Hubris 6, TV 2 reports, citing an Oslo District Court judgment from March 2026. As reported by TV 2, the court convicted five men of serious drug offences; the longest sentence was 16 years and 3 months, and the judgment has been appealed. According to the judgment as reported by TV 2, a courier received cash and exchanged it into the cryptocurrency Tether. Kripos says the exchanges, over about four months in 2024, came to more than 70 million Norwegian kroner, and that more than 23 million Norwegian kroner has been frozen.
